content.value_statement: Building a production REST API requires aligned requirements, implementation, testing, documentation, and deployment. This skill provides a two-week TDD workflow for coordinating specialized agents.
actual_capabilities: Defines a 14-day REST API delivery plan from requirements through launch.
Coordinates product, architecture, database, QA, backend, documentation, and DevOps responsibilities.
Specifies deliverables for requirements, OpenAPI specs, schemas, test plans, CI, docs, and deployment.
Applies a TDD cycle for endpoint tests, implementation, review, and refactoring.
Covers E2E, performance, security, staging, production, monitoring, and knowledge transfer steps.
Lists measurable success targets for coverage, latency, uptime, throughput, and documentation.
limitations: It is a workflow template, not a generated API implementation.
It assumes compatible agent roles and tool access are already available.
It does not validate real infrastructure, secrets, or production permissions.
Timeline, targets, and stack choices need adjustment for each project.

use_cases.title: Plan a New API Build
use_cases.description: Turn an API idea into phased requirements, architecture, database, testing, and DevOps workstreams.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Backend Delivery
use_cases.description: Guide implementation teams through TDD endpoint development, review, documentation, and release readiness.

use_cases.title: Prepare Launch Operations
use_cases.description: Create staging, production, monitoring, rollback, runbook, and support handoff steps before launch.

prompt_templates.title: Start an API Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this REST API SOP to plan a new API for my product. Ask for missing requirements before assigning workstreams.

prompt_templates.title: Create Delivery Phases
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the two-week SOP to my API project. Produce phase goals, agent responsibilities, deliverables, and review checkpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Run TDD Endpoint Work
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the SOP to coordinate TDD delivery for these endpoints. Include tests, implementation tasks, reviews, and documentation outputs.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Production Release
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the deployment and validation sections to prepare staging, production rollout, monitoring, rollback, and knowledge transfer plans.

output_examples.input: Plan a user management REST API with authentication and role permissions.
output_examples.output: A phased delivery plan with requirements, OpenAPI design, database schema, TDD tasks, testing scope, documentation, and deployment checks.

output_examples.input: Coordinate production readiness for an API already in staging.
output_examples.output: A launch checklist covering final validation, smoke tests, monitoring, rollback, traffic shift, documentation updates, and support handoff.

output_examples.input: Define test coverage for a new endpoint group.
output_examples.output: A test plan covering unit, integration, E2E, performance, security, edge cases, and acceptance criteria.

best_practices: Confirm requirements, data models, and authentication rules before implementation starts.
Write tests before endpoint implementation and keep review outputs tied to each endpoint.
Validate staging, rollback, monitoring, and documentation before production traffic moves.
anti_patterns: Starting backend implementation before API contracts and database schema are reviewed.
Treating generated tasks as production approval without human security and operations review.
Using default timelines or performance targets without adapting them to project constraints.

faq.question: Does this skill build the API code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides a structured workflow and task prompts for coordinating API delivery.

faq.question: What API style does it target?
faq.answer: It targets REST APIs with OpenAPI documentation, database design, TDD, and staged deployment.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Does it include security testing?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes OWASP API checks, injection testing, authorization checks, and rate limit validation.

faq.question: Can the two-week timeline be changed?
faq.answer: Yes. Treat the timeline as a planning baseline and adapt it to scope, team size, and risk.

faq.question: What should teams prepare before using it?
faq.answer: Prepare product goals, initial endpoint ideas, target stack, deployment environment, and available agent roles.
